title: Wendell and the Parish
author: Elodie Thackeray
blurb: Wren Coldharbour, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
